notes: Self-declared "collectathon adventure" whose stated activity is exploring an open 3D world and gathering scattered coins, so Adventure leads on world-open and the Scavenger Hunt preset covers it; Obby & Platformer is named second for the running and jumping across raised platforms, and because it does not lead, its genre-wide P6 does not follow it in. Expressed the platforming with obstacle-jump, which carries no pipeline cost, rather than path-track, whose P6 assumes an ordered course - this world is explored in any order - and read the raised platforms as elevation reached by jumping rather than structure that overhangs, so the build stays on the proven P0 route. Dropped the preset's tracker-quest because the coin count lives on a HUD rather than on a physical board, and added gate-progression for the goal that only opens at the coin threshold plus winner-zone for the payoff behind it, since the run needs a reachable end. Decided without a user, as the prompt demanded no questions: ten coins to open the goal, one small stylized readable slice, and respawn handled as a return point for players who fall off the world.
